app.name: SmartSeed
app.tagline: Check your seeds before you sow

language.title: Choose your language
language.subtitle: You can change this later in Profile.

home.title: SmartSeed
home.welcome: Scan the QR code on the seed packet to check it.

scanner.title: Scan QR code
scanner.hint: Point the camera at the QR code on the seed packet.
scanner.permissionBody: SmartSeed uses the camera only to read the QR code on the packet. No photos are saved.
scanner.notSmartSeed: This is not a SmartSeed code. Do not rely on it. Look for the SmartSeed QR code on the packet.

verify.title: Check result
verify.offlineBanner: Saved information may be outdated. Check again when online.
verify.noSavedCopy: No internet and no saved information for this packet. Connect and try again.
verify.errorTimeout: The connection is too slow. Please try again.
verify.errorNotFound: This code was not found. Do not trust this packet. You can report it.
verify.errorRateLimited: Too many checks. Please wait a minute and try again.
verify.errorServer: The service is busy. Please try again shortly.
verify.errorInvalid: We could not read the answer from the server. Please try again.
verify.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
verify.expiredWarning: This batch has passed its expiry date. Do not use these seeds.

GREEN.title: All checks passed
GREEN.body: All four checks below passed. Still check that the packet seal is intact.

YELLOW.title: Be careful
YELLOW.body: Some checks could not be confirmed. Ask the shop for help or check again before buying or sowing.

RED.title: Do not use
RED.body: A check failed or this product is flagged. Do not buy or sow these seeds. Please report it.

LAST_CHECKED.title: Last checked earlier
LAST_CHECKED.body: This is an older result. It does not show that the packet is safe now. Check again when online.

digitalIdentity.name: Packet identity
digitalIdentity.VALID: The QR code is registered by the manufacturer. This alone does not prove the seeds are real.
digitalIdentity.REVOKED: This QR code was cancelled by the manufacturer. Do not use it.
digitalIdentity.UNKNOWN: We could not confirm who registered this code.

blockchain.name: Tamper-proof record
blockchain.VERIFIED: The packet's history matches the secure shared record.
blockchain.UNVERIFIED: We could not check the secure record yet. Try again later.
blockchain.FAILED: The packet's history does NOT match the secure record. It may be fake or altered.

scanActivity.name: Scan activity
scanActivity.NORMAL: This code has been scanned a normal number of times.
scanActivity.SUSPICIOUS: This code has been scanned in unusual ways. It may be copied.

investigation.name: Investigation
investigation.NONE: No investigation is open for this batch.
investigation.UNDER_INVESTIGATION: This batch is being investigated. Be careful.
investigation.CONFIRMED_COUNTERFEIT: This batch was confirmed to be counterfeit. Do not use it.

journey.title: Where it has been
journey.empty: No journey steps are listed for this packet.

risk.title: Risk status

explain.MEDIUM: Some unusual signs were found. Be careful.
explain.HIGH: Many warning signs were found. Do not use without advice.
explain.CRITICAL: Serious warning signs were found. Do not use.

risk.notAssessedBody: This packet has not been scored for risk yet. This is not the same as low risk.

report.title: Report a suspicious packet
report.intro: Tell us if this packet looks fake or tampered with. Your report is anonymous.
report.success: Thank you. Your report was sent.
report.failure: The report could not be sent. Please try again.
report.noToken: Scan a SmartSeed packet first, then report it from the result screen.

history.title: My past checks
history.empty: You have not checked any packet yet.

notifications.title: Alerts
notifications.denied: Alerts are blocked. You can allow them in phone settings.
notifications.error: Could not load alerts. Please try again.

profile.title: Profile
profile.deviceHint: No name or phone number is needed.

a11y.scanFrame: Camera view for scanning a QR code

tts.stale: This is saved information and may be outdated.

warning.QR_UNKNOWN: This code is not recognised. Do not trust this packet.
warning.QR_REVOKED: This QR code was cancelled by the manufacturer.
warning.QR_SUPERSEDED: This QR code was replaced by a newer one. This may be an old or copied label.
warning.BATCH_EXPIRED: This batch has passed its expiry date.
warning.CHAIN_VERIFICATION_FAILED: The packet history does not match the secure record.
warning.CHAIN_NOT_YET_CONFIRMED: The secure record has not been confirmed yet. Check again later.
warning.SUSPICIOUS_SCAN_ACTIVITY: This code has been scanned in unusual ways.
warning.CONFIRMED_COUNTERFEIT: This batch was confirmed to be counterfeit.
warning.HIGH_RISK: This packet has a high risk score.
warning.OTHER: Something needs attention. Check with the seller.

unknown.title: This code is not recognised
unknown.body: SmartSeed has no record of this code. Do not buy or sow from this packet. You can report it.
